final_claim: Three disjoint equal-width intervals of unknown common width are uniquely recovered up to translation/reflection by I(0), I″(0), I⁽⁶⁾(0); order five insufficient, fourth derivative redundant; inverse uniformly 1/2-Hölder on compact separated families, sharp at equal start spacings.
limitations: Exactly three pairwise disjoint equal-width intervals; only exact derivatives at 0; no identification among arbitrary measurable signals.
Uniform stability requires compact positive width/gap conditions; reflection ambiguity unavoidable.
